name: pam_geoip
detailed_description: PAM module using MaxMind GeoIP2 database for geographic access control. Restricts login access based on user's physical location using IP geolocation.

parameters.allowed_countries: Comma-separated list of allowed country codes
parameters.denied_countries: Comma-separated list of denied country codes

notes:
Requires GeoIP2 MaxMind database subscription. Useful for preventing unauthorized geographic access.
